transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. Can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me?

I came in because my eating got completely off track. I stopped caring about tracking my food, skipped actual meals for days, and mostly just had coffee and protein bars. Then I noticed my clothes were hanging loose on me.

When you were cutting back on food, were you doing it because you were afraid of gaining weight or unhappy with your body shape, or was it more that you just weren't hungry or didn't feel like eating?

It wasn’t really about my weight or how I looked. I just stopped paying attention to food—I’d go days without a real meal, just coffee and protein bars. I didn’t really notice how much weight I’d lost until my clothes were loose.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you'd normally enjoy?
Yeah. After the sponsor questioned my judgment, it felt like the bottom dropped out. I just sat in my apartment feeling hollow and ashamed, crying over emails I normally would’ve just handled.
How long has this feeling of hollowness, sadness, and loss of interest been going on—days, or has it been at least two weeks?
It’s been about three months now. It didn’t just last a few days—it’s kind of dragged on since the project crisis.
During these past three months, have you had any thoughts of wanting to hurt yourself or that you'd be better off dead?
Yeah. I started thinking everyone at work would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. After that meeting, I said out loud that I should just walk into traffic and be done with it.
During this time, have you experienced anything like hearing voices, seeing things that others don't, or having beliefs that others find strange or untrue?

Yeah. When I was at my most wired, I heard the project dashboard pinging and people calling my name from empty conference rooms. And one time in my bedroom, I saw lines of numbers crawling across the wall, like they were giving me instructions.
You mentioned feeling 'most wired'—can you tell me more about that time? Did you notice your mood being unusually high, energetic, or irritable, along with needing much less sleep than usual?

For a few days, I felt almost unstoppable—like I was brilliant and everything was obvious. But if anyone asked me a basic question or tried to slow me down, I’d snap at them. It felt like they were sabotaging the whole company.
Did the voices and the numbers you saw on the wall happen only during that 'wired,' high-energy period, or have you also experienced them during the times you felt hollow and depressed?

Only during that wired stretch. I was barely sleeping and felt like I could remake the whole company. Before that, when I felt normal, and then after I crashed and got depressed, I wasn’t hearing the voices or seeing the numbers.
How many days in a row did that 'wired,' high-energy, less-need-for-sleep period last before it ended?
It built up over about three weeks, after I was given that temporary PMO-level responsibility.

During this current three-month period of feeling hollow and depressed, have you had any hearing voices, seeing things, or having beliefs that others might find strange—separate from the earlier wired episode?

No. That stuff—the voices, dashboard pings, the numbers on the wall—was only during that wired period when I barely slept. Before it, when I felt normal, and since I crashed into this depressed state, I haven’t been hearing or seeing those things.
